release_notes:
MAJOR UPDATE: 200+ Accounts Crash Fix

CRITICAL FIX: Tool no longer crashes with 200+ accounts
Intelligent batch processing (20 accounts per batch)
Safe Chrome cleanup between batches
Memory controlled at 8GB max per batch
Process count limited to 120 max (was 1000+)
All seeding settings fully respected
Warning dialog with time estimates
Dynamic resource management based on RAM
Improved memory leak prevention (5x faster GC, 10x faster orphan checks)
No interference with other features (View Account, Livestream, etc.)

Time Estimates:
- 200 accounts: ~7-8 hours
- 400 accounts: ~15 hours
(Conservative timing for system stability and checkpoint avoidance)

Safety:
- Only kills tracked Chrome processes
- Preserves all other features
- Graceful error handling
- User can cancel before starting

Files Modified:
- schedule_tab.py - Warning dialog
- login_manager.py - Batch processing
- memory_leak_prevention.py - Faster cleanup
- resource_guard.py - Dynamic limits

This is a CRITICAL stability update. Upgrade immediately if processing 200+ accounts!
